t: Easyfix zinc-plated screw eyes are robust carbon steel fixings designed for secure indoor applications. These versatile screw eyes are ideal for various domestic and commercial projects, such as installing curtain poles, hanging frames, or securing lighting fixtures. Manufactured from durable carbon steel with a protective zinc-plated finish, they offer reliable performance. Each 12 gauge, 55mm screw eye supports a maximum load of 5kg and is suitable for chipboard, timber, and wood. Their removable and reusable design provides flexibility for temporary or permanent installations.
b: Suitable for Installing Curtain Poles, Frames, Lighting, Shelves, Mirrors & TV Mounting
